settings.subtitle: About Yurichan 🐾
settings.title: Crafted with Love for Every Best Friend
settings.description: At Yurichan Store, we believe pets are family. We design adorable, comfortable, and durable products to make every moment with your furry friend special.

settings.heading: From Our Family to Yours
settings.story_text:
Yurichan Store started with a simple mission: to create cute, high-quality pet essentials that don't compromise on comfort or safety.

Every accessory, bed, and toy is thoughtfully designed and tested with our own pets to ensure maximum durability and happiness.
